title: Dummy Backend Profile Widget
description: Build a small profile widget that reads from the dummy backend's /api/profile endpoint, handling loading, error, and refresh states.
requirements: Fetch profile data from http://localhost:4000/api/profile on mount using useEffect
While loading, render a div with class 'profile-widget loading' containing text 'Loading profile...'
On error, render a div with class 'profile-widget error' that shows 'Error: <message>' and a 'Retry' button that re-fetches the profile
When no profile is loaded but there is no error, render a div with class 'profile-widget empty' and a 'Load profile' button that triggers a fetch
When profile is loaded, render a div with class 'profile-widget loaded' containing an h1 'Profile Widget', an h2 with the user's name, and a paragraph showing the role
Include a 'Refresh' button in the loaded state that re-fetches from the backend
Use the Profile interface for typed profile data

browserTests.name: Refresh button exists in loaded state

hints.state: You need profile, loading, and error state variables.
hints.fetch: Call fetch('http://localhost:4000/api/profile') inside an async helper and use try/catch/finally.
hints.retry: Reuse the same loadProfile function for initial load, Retry, and Refresh.
